news.contents: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones will remain the starter for Thursday night's Week 11 game at the Houston Texans, head coach Shane Steichen said after Sunday's win over the Miami Dolphins, according to Kevin Bowen. Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the 24-22 win that snapped a five-game losing streak. His seven-yard touchdown pass to Laquon Treadwell put Indianapolis ahead late in the first half. Miami cornerback Chris Johnson ...
news.title: Daniel Jones to Start Thursday Against Houston

news.contents: The Minnesota Vikings' acquisition of veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins should elevate the team's struggling offense, which could mean additional chances for running back Aaron Jones Sr. in Week 10 at Green Bay. The former Packer has just 64 rushing yards in the past three games, but Minnesota's offense has been so helpless that it's hard to fault the team's running backs for the team's inability to stay on the field. Cousins, however, is intimately familiar with the scheme, and any ...
news.title: New-Look Offense Could Benefit Aaron Jones Sr. In Week 10

news.analysis: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.
news.contents: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
news.title: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday

news.contents: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price totaled nine carries, 36 rushing yards, and a rushing touchdown during Sunday's Week 10 win over the Las Vegas Raiders. He also converted his lone target into an eight-yard reception. As Zach Charbonnet continues to take on more volume and occupy the lead-back role, Price has seen less involvement on offense. Sunday's 10 touches were his second-lowest mark of the season, albeit over just six games. When he was coming out of college just over six ...
news.title: Jadarian Price Makes Up for Modest Role with a Touchdown

news.analysis: It was a low volume day for Kamara, but he made the most of it with two touchdowns. His role was considered up in the air with Travis Etienne returning and Audric Estime playing well, but the veteran was able to produce when it mattered Sunday. Kamara and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11 .
news.contents: Alvin Kamara rushed for four yards and a touchdown on two carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 10 yards and a touchdown.
news.title: Alvin Kamara finds the end zone in Week 10

news.contents: New Orleans Saints running back Alvin Kamara rushed just six times for 32 yards and added three catches for another 17 yards in Week 9's victory over the Browns. Kamara out-snapped fellow running back Audric Estime 37-35, though it was Estime who out-gained him 77-49 in total yards. Kamara's inefficient season continues, as he is averaging just 3.3 yards per carry on 6.7 attempts per game, both career lows. news.title: Alvin Kamara's Role in New Orleans Backfield Remains Uncertain

news.analysis: Williams finished second on the team in targets in the lopsided win while hitting at least 50 receiving yards for the fourth time over his past six contests. He will be a boom/bust WR3 for fantasy heading into Week 11 vs. the Buccaneers.
news.contents: Jameson Williams caught four of his seven targets for 50 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver CeeDee Lamb has drawn 20 red-zone targets through nine games, a source of scoring chances against a defense that has held wide receivers to 27.2 PPR points per game as a group. San Francisco gave up 73 yards to Raiders wideouts last week, with Tre Tucker accounting for 55. Lamb is still a WR1 and sits at WR2 in RotoBaller's weekend PPR rankings. news.analysis: Kelce was hampered by a lingering ankle injury, exiting briefly on his way to finishing with less than four receptions for the first time in his last five games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.
news.contents: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.title: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 10 win

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce (ankle) returned to Sunday's Week 10 game against the Atlanta Falcons after leaving with an ankle injury, according to Matt McMullen. Kelce's only catch before exiting went for 23 yards on Kansas City's opening drive and ended with a tackle by DeMarcco Hellams. Kelce went to the locker room and was initially listed as questionable to return. Fellow Chiefs tight end Jared Wiley was ruled out with an ankle injury.
news.title: Travis Kelce Returns Against Falcons After Ankle Injury

news.contents: Brandon McManus was 2-for-2 on field goals and 4-of-4 on extra point attempts.
news.title: Brandon McManus connects on all six kicks Sunday

news.contents: Los Angeles Rams kicker Brandon McManus is an appealing streamer for Sunday's Week 10 contest against the Arizona Cardinals. McManus has been money since signing with the Rams, going 10-for-10 on extra points and 3-for-3 on field goals across three games. For several years now, Rams kickers have been riskier fantasy options because they don't often attempt field goals. news.analysis: Most of Jeudy's production Sunday came on a season-long 65-yard gain late in the second quarter. The veteran receiver has now caught multiple passes in six of the last seven games, but he's topped out at four. Overall, Jeudy has 20 receptions at just over 14 yards per with no touchdowns through 10 games.
